Contact Clipora support · Existing reports

Keep your data private

Reports are public and require a GitHub account. Include Windows version, Clipora version, reproduction steps and synthetic examples only. Never include real clipboard history, private file paths, encryption keys, passwords or access tokens. GitHub handles account and report data under its own privacy policy. Clipora has no email support address at this time.

Common fixes

Startup: enable Settings → General → Start with Windows. Windows Settings → Apps → Startup can disable it independently.

Paste: put the caret in a normal input, press Ctrl+Alt+V and click a clip. Windows can block input into elevated apps; use Copy and Ctrl+V there.

Backups: export a password-encrypted backup before resetting or uninstalling. Restore merges the backup into the current library. Keep the password safe.

Desktop to Store: use Backup & restore to transfer clips into the Store app's separate Windows-managed storage.
